svg.title: As-built feather templates - 42 feathers, 1:1 mm, vertical flip
svg.desc: Aggregate of as-built/vectors/individuals/*.svg, one group per feather prefix. Each outline is copied verbatim from its individual file and only translated and mirrored (vertical) about its own centre, so it stays 1:1 (user units = mm) and keeps its label.
